name: Era Timeline
shortDescription: A zoomable timeline of eras and events for a family, a project, or a course.
description: A timeline you can pan and zoom, of whatever you are keeping: a family's generations, a project's history, a course's periods. Eras are translucent layered bands whose labels slide along to stay in view; events are pins that sort themselves into lanes so nothing overlaps at any zoom, and open a card with their text, a picture, and their era. Drag to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom, and the axis relabels itself from centuries to decades, years, months, and days. A minimap shows where you are and can be dragged. Story mode walks every event in order, easing the camera from one to the next. On a phone the timeline runs down the screen and cards open as a sheet. It also prints as one long strip with the title at the left. Your agent writes the eras and events from what you tell it, in one sitting or over months.
